formats.key: swapExactAmountIn(address executor, (address srcToken, address destToken, uint256 fromAmount, uint256 toAmount, uint256 quotedAmount, bytes32 metadata, address beneficiary) swapData, uint256 partnerAndFee, bytes permit, bytes executorData)
effects: Pulls exactly fromAmount of srcToken from the signer (or takes msg.value equal to fromAmount when srcToken is 0xEeee) and sends it to the hidden executor.
Optionally runs an ERC-2612, DAI or Permit2 permit from the hidden permit bytes, which sets or uses an allowance on the signer's srcToken.
Sends destToken to the beneficiary (the signer when it is zero) after Augustus checks its balance against toAmount.
A partner fee or a surplus share (set by the hidden partnerAndFee) is cut from the destToken output before it is paid out, and 1 wei is kept as dust.
formats.shown: "Swap", with the amount to send in srcToken, the minimum to receive in destToken, and the beneficiary.

findings.title: swapExactAmountIn: the hidden partner fee is cut after the minimum check, so 'Minimum to Receive' is not guaranteed.
findings.evidence: AugustusFees.processSwapExactAmountInFeesAndTransfer takes fee = feeBase*feePercent/10000 (feePercent up to 200 bps) out of receivedAmount and has no toAmount check. Descriptor: partnerAndFee is 'visible: never', and toAmount is labelled 'Minimum to Receive'. Case 0 stayed above the minimum (3.109927 ≥ 3.100598 USDT); sibling case 7 (Pro) fell below it.
findings.fix: Show partnerAndFee's fee percent, or relabel toAmount as 'Minimum before fees'.

findings.title: swapExactAmountIn: the executor that receives the signer's tokens and the permit bytes are hidden.
findings.evidence: Code: srcToken.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, executor, amountIn), and srcToken.permit(permit) runs when permit.length > 0. Descriptor: #.executor and #.permit are 'visible: never'. The output is still bounded by the toAmount check on Augustus's balance.
findings.fix: Optionally show the executor as an address field.

findings.title: swapExactAmountIn: the intent 'Swap' has no interpolated intent naming the tokens and amounts.
findings.evidence: descriptor formats.swapExactAmountIn: intent 'Swap', no interpolatedIntent
findings.fix: Add an interpolatedIntent such as 'Swap {fromAmount} for at least {toAmount}'.

cases.notes: 3.11 USDC out; 3.109927 USDT in, above the 3.100598 minimum. 28 USDT surplus went to the fee vault.

Case 7 screen: 'Minimum to Receive 2.127035 USDC'; mined: 2140539 USDC arrives, 20660 goes to 0x0070…10cc, the signer gets 2119879.
